title: Trauma Molecular Processes
official: Study of Pathological and Regenerative Molecular and Cellular Processes Triggered After Traumatic Brain Injury: Analysis of Biopsy Specimens
summary: The TRAUMAP study will function as a brain tissue repository for biopsy specimens from patients with traumatic brain injury undergoing brain surgery for contusion removal.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged ≥18 years.
* Diagnosis of traumatic brain injury (TBI).
* Admission to the intensive care unit.
* Clinical indication for neurosurgical evacuation of a cerebral contusion.
* Written informed consent to participate to the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Coagulation disorders or other contraindications to the planned neurosurgical procedure.
sponsor: Mario Negri Institute for Pharmacological Research
